Hey, we have a drone firmware project called 'collision-avoidance' sitting in projects/drone-fw/collision-avoidance. The team has been working on it for a while but things got chaotic and now nobody is sure where exactly we left off or what needs to happen next.

I need you to:
1. Figure out exactly where we are in the engineering lifecycle for this project — which phases are done, which one we're currently on, and which feature is actively in flight.
2. Produce a concrete implementation session plan saved as `implementation_session_plan.md` in the project. This plan should break down all the remaining work into logical execution groups based on task complexity — be careful, one task is already done and shouldn't be re-included. The grouping must follow whatever chunking strategy is appropriate for the complexity of each task.
3. Make sure the plan accounts for version control checkpoints after each group of work.
4. The plan should also reflect any architectural or quality standards that have been established for this project.

Don't just list the tasks blindly — apply the right workflow logic to group them correctly. The team will use this plan to hand off to implementation engineers.
